subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed subagent startup failures stay accepted and become a typed async terminal failure, or should `sessions_spawn` preflight Docker startup before returning accepted?
rationale: Both designs can address the silent hang, but the choice changes the public non-blocking spawn contract, gateway wait behavior, and the broader startup lifecycle work in #58776.

options.title: Terminalize async startup failure
options.body: Keep the immediate accepted response and add a typed, logged terminal state visible through subagent status/history/wait paths when sandbox startup fails.

options.title: Preflight sandbox before accept
options.body: Move enough sandbox backend validation ahead of the accepted response and reject immediately, accepting added latency and compatibility impact.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle tracker
options.body: Keep this issue as the sandbox-specific proof case while #58776 decides the broader startup progress/failure lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Terminalize async startup failure
recommendation.body: Keep the immediate accepted response and add a typed, logged terminal state visible through subagent status/history/wait paths when sandbox startup fails.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest historical signal is the existing sessions_spawn sandbox inheritance and sandbox backend ownership trail.
